Description: A weak-field gravitational-lensing approximation with radial deflection, twist, and Einstein-ring-style distortion.
KScript: var r2 := x*x + y*y + z*z + v1; var deflection := v0/(r2 + 0.001); var twist := t*v2*deflection + u*v3; var c := cos(twist); var s := sin(twist); var ox := x; var oy := y; var lx := ox*c - oy*s; var ly := ox*s + oy*c; x := ox + (lx-ox)*deflection; y := oy + (ly-oy)*deflection; z += deflection*v4; ry += deflection*v5*rad;
